title: feat(app-shell): Data pillar Form tab — one toolbar row, section and field cards (objectui#12451)
body:
Fixes #12451
Clause-②: no

The Data pillar's Form tab after the layout skeleton (objectui#12459) and the Data pillar card (objectui#12450): one toolbar row under the tab row, a sidebar-tinted canvas, section cards, field cards with a type tag and a selection ring, and a dashed add-section footer. Part of epic objectui#12446 (decisions 1 and 3; decision D's principle for the column rule).

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## What changed

**Form toolbar** (`ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`, new exported `FormToolbar`; `DataPillar` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`)
- Exactly one row between the tab row and the first section card, in Layout and in Preview: 12 px vertical padding, background surface, bottom border.
- At the left, the compact Layout / Preview control (24 px items), owned by `DataPillar` and handed to the designer as `modeControl`. The sentence that used to trail it moved into each item's `title`: the Layout item carries "Draft layout", "Draft layout — your unsaved changes" or the read-only caption by the same three-way rule (objectui#4036, objectui#11781); the Preview item carries "Preview of the published version".
- Then a 12 px muted hint, the new key `engine.studio.designer.toolbarHint` ("Drag fields to arrange · click a field to edit its properties", en and zh). A read-only package keeps its existing read-only hint there.
- At the right, in Layout on a writable package: an outline chip that adds a section and a primary-soft "Add field" chip, both 28 px.
- In Preview the same row holds the control and, when there are local edits or a draft, the existing amber "preview shows the published version" chip. No second row.
- The Form tab's body is now flush with the content column like Records (`formFlush` beside `recordsFlush`); the error and held-edit strips keep their 24 px inset in both flush views.

**One Add field implementation.** The toolbar chip calls `onAddField`, which `DataPillar` passes as the same `addField` callback the object header's More menu item runs. Pinned by `DataPillar.formToolbar-12451`: each path adds one field card and opens the inspector.

**Canvas, section card, field card** (`ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`)
- Canvas: `bg-sidebar`, 24 px padding, 16 px between sections.
- Section card: background surface, 1 px border, 8 px radius. A 44 px header with the 14 px / 600 title (still the inline rename input on a writable package), "N fields" at 12 px muted, then move up, move down, delete, and the section settings icon button (28 px) at the right. The settings button still opens `ObjectGroupInspector`; only its look changed. The field grid has 12 px padding and an 8 px gap.
- Field card: 10 by 12 px padding, 6 px radius, a transparent border that turns to the border colour on hover; a 13 px / 500 label with a red asterisk when required and a 10 px uppercase type tag beside it; then a 32 px skeleton (56 px for the multi-line types, a select box with a chevron for pickers). Selected: a 1 px primary border plus a 3 px primary/10 ring, and the type tag turns primary.
- Footer: a dashed 44 px button under the last section that adds a section (not drawn on a read-only package).

Drag-and-drop, keyboard reordering and their announcements (objectui#11802, objectui#11871, objectui#11898) are untouched: the cards keep their sortable wiring, `cursor-grab`, the `min-h-[52px]` grid and the `h-14` multi-line skeleton those suites read. Selection still opens the field inspector exactly as before.

## Deviations from the artboard (`data-form.png`)

1. **Fixed 3 columns.** The artboard's grid is `repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))`. The designer keeps the runtime form's rule: `inferColumns` sets the cap from the field count and `containerGridColsFor` clamps it to the section's width with container queries ("Column count mirrors the real form", objectui#2578; pinned by `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx`, unmodified and green). Reason: decision D's principle (the Studio preview keeps the runtime's look where they share a rule). At 1280 px with the inspector open the screenshot shows 3 columns because the cap is 3 and the section is wide enough; a lighter object shows fewer.
2. **A wide field spans the full row, not two columns.** Textarea and the other wide types take `col-span-full`, the runtime form's `isWideFieldType` rule (pinned by `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx`). Same reason.
3. **Add-section copy.** The toolbar chip and the footer read "Add group" (existing key `engine.studio.designer.addGroup`), not "Add section" / "Add a section". Reason: the same canvas says "Ungrouped", "Group settings", "Move group up" and "Delete group"; the ruling keeps existing keys, and a second word for the same thing on one canvas would be a new inconsistency. Changing the vocabulary is a copy decision for the epic, not this card.
4. **No drag grip on the section header.** Sections reorder with the move up / move down buttons; there is no section drag. A grip would promise a gesture the canvas does not honour, so it is not drawn. The move and delete buttons the artboard omits stay, because they are the section's only reorder and delete controls.
5. **"1 fields".** The section count reuses the object header's `engine.studio.data.fieldCount` ("{count} fields"), which has no singular form. Noted, not changed here.
6. **Sample data.** Under `objectstack dev` HotCRM's package is read-only (no add actions), so the screenshots use a writable local base "Acme CRM" with an Account draft shaped like the artboard's section (8 fields in "Basic Information"). The platform-injected Owner lookup lands in an "Ungrouped" section below it. The inspector, shell header and tab row are other cards' (objectui#12449's aside, objectui#12450, objectui#12452, objectui#12453).

Source last changed at `d393034`; the final head `725f0ef` adds the screenshots and one test-only change.
- The card's named suites plus `StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyWording-11781` (11 files): `Test Files 11 passed (11)`, `Tests 85 passed (85)`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`, in two runs at `e03a482`: the 100 files that are not `StudioDesignSurface.*`: `Test Files 100 passed (100)`, `Tests 782 passed (782)`; the 76 `StudioDesignSurface.*` files: 75 passed, 1 failed (`draftVersionConflict-11773`: its global `N fields` read found the header's and the new section count). Fixed in `725f0ef` by scoping the read to `data-object-header`: `Tests 7 passed (7)`.
- **New:** `DataPillar.formToolbar-12451.test.tsx` (4 tests: one toolbar in Layout and in Preview, its contents, the canvas directly after it, one Add field action, the read-only control) and `ObjectFormDesigner.cards-12451.test.tsx` (5 tests: section count and settings trigger, the selection ring and primary type tag, required asterisk, select and textarea skeletons, the footer adding a section, the read-only control). `Tests 9 passed (9)`.
- **Updated for the moved caption:** `DataPillar.layoutBadge.test.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyWording-11781.test.tsx` read the caption by title instead of text, and the writable hint by the new key. Assertions otherwise unchanged.
- **Ablated once each** (mutation written with an anchor count check, run, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - Layout title always the clean caption: `layoutBadge` "read-only package: no unsaved-changes claim" and `readOnlyWording` "read-only: …" went red (`Tests 2 failed | 6 passed`).
  - A second toolbar in Preview: `formToolbar-12451` "Preview: the same single toolbar row" red (`1 failed | 3 passed`).
  - No selection ring: `cards-12451` "a selected field draws the primary border and ring" red (`1 failed | 4 passed`).
  - The hint back on the old key: `readOnlyWording` CONTROL and `formToolbar-12451` "Layout: one toolbar holds …" red (`2 failed | 6 passed`).
  - The other named suites are unmodified and green; their behaviour did not change, so they were not ablated.
- `machineLocaleCensus-9909`, `ariaLabelLiteralCensus-12145`, `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet`: `Tests 44 passed (44)` (no new `Intl.*` call).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 (dependency closure built first). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build`: exit 0, dist completeness verified.
- eslint on every touched file: 0 errors; the warnings are on lines this diff does not touch.
- Gates, exit 0 each: `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift` (1 key added, 0 values changed), `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new). `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- `ObjectGroupInspector.tsx` is unchanged: the section settings trigger lives in `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`, and that is where its look changed.
- Two test files outside the claim's file list were edited, both test-only: `StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyWording-11781.test.tsx` pins the same moved caption, and `StudioDesignSurface.draftVersionConflict-11773.test.tsx` read the header's field count unscoped.
- `engine.studio.designer.hint` is no longer read by any call site; it stays because the ruling keeps existing keys. Carrier: none.
- The geometry constants in the keyboard-grid suite (objectui#11898) describe the old card metrics; that suite's logic is self-consistent and green, and it does not measure real layout.
- `origin/main` moved one commit after the branch point (`03cf7b2`, a test-only change); no overlap, and `git merge-tree` reports no conflict.
